title: Pure SPYRAL
summary: SPYRAL cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Everything revolves around SPYRAL Super Agent. It summons itself from the hand by correctly guessing the type of the opponent's top card, and destroys a Spell/Trap when a SPYRAL card summons it. SPYRAL GEAR - Drone stacks their top three cards first, so the guesses land. SPYRAL Quik-Fix searches a GEAR card, SPYRAL Resort searches a SPYRAL monster every turn and stops them targeting your other SPYRAL cards, and SPYRAL Double Helix takes on the Super Agent's name and fetches more agents. SPYRAL Double Agent, the newest card, summons itself to their field to reveal both top cards and lets Super Agent attack directly. SPYRAL Master Plan is Forbidden.
